name: Question 3
problem:
A tank initially holds $540\,\text{L}$ of a chemical solution containing $22\,\text{kg}$ of dissolved chemical.
A chemical solution containing $0.15\,\text{kg}$ of dissolved chemical per liter is poured into the tank at a rate of $18\,\text{L/min},$ while the completely mixed solution leaves the tank at a rate of $18\,\text{L/min}.$ Which differential equation best describes the amount of dissolved chemical $Q,$ in kilograms, in the tank $t$ minutes after the solution begins to be added?

Question 3
?

A tank initially holds 540L of a chemical solution containing 22kg of dissolved chemical. A chemical solution containing 0.15kg of dissolved chemical per liter is poured into the tank at a rate of 18L/min, while the completely mixed solution leaves the tank at a rate of 18L/min. Which differential equation best describes the amount of dissolved chemical Q, in kilograms, in the tank t minutes after the solution begins to be added?

a
dQdt−130Q=2.7
b
dQdt−140Q=2.7
c
dQdt+130Q=0
d
dQdt+130Q=2.7
e
dQdt+140Q=2.7
